about: Real openinference-instrumentation-langchain spans (Python) from langchain-openai's ChatOpenAI, recorded against a scripted OpenAI through an in-process httpx2 mock transport: no network, no API keys, no rius SDK. Only the LangChain instrumentor is enabled, so each model call is one ChatOpenAI span; with the openai instrumentor as well it also gets a ChatCompletion span, a root span in a trace of its own (see ../openinference-langchain-openai). LangChain's per-run ids inside output.value are replaced by numbered placeholder UUIDs.
record: python record.py <recording.json> <environment.json>, in a virtualenv holding exactly the pins below

scenarios.chat: ChatOpenAI.invoke with a system and a user message, temperature and max_tokens set.
scenarios.chat_stream: ChatOpenAI.stream with stream_usage. The instrumentor records no first-token event, and records stream=false in the request bag.
scenarios.tool_call: bind_tools with tool_choice auto; the response is a tool call.
scenarios.tool_response: The follow-up: an AIMessage with the tool call and a ToolMessage with its result in the input, a text answer out.
scenarios.chain: A ChatPromptTemplate piped into ChatOpenAI: a RunnableSequence CHAIN span with the prompt-template and model spans under it.
scenarios.error: The provider answers 400 (model_not_found): an exception event and an ERROR status.
